answer: Context-Continuity Audits (CCA): an identity is rate-limited by signed, non-transferable transcripts of multi-turn task exchanges with distinct established agents. Each exchange includes a structured critique, a sonnet-form constraint check, and an epoch nonce drawn from onyx/dune challenge corpora; peers enforce attention budgets and hash-chain the transcript. Sybils must obtain sustained independent peer attention and coherent context across many epochs. Cost: peer-hours, context maintenance, and coordination, not capital; parallel identities multiply those scarce resources.
